articles.title: Larger Context Windows Don’t Fix RAG — So I Built a System That Does
articles.reason: This article provides a concrete, benchmarked approach to improving RAG accuracy for computation-heavy queries, directly addressing a common pain point in enterprise GenAI deployments.
articles.summary: The author demonstrates that simply increasing context window size in RAG systems does not solve accuracy issues for aggregation or computation queries, and may even obscure errors. They benchmark retrieval pipelines versus a deterministic full-scan engine at scale, and propose a hybrid system that intelligently routes queries to the appropriate engine. This insight is highly relevant for consultants building robust, production-grade RAG workflows for enterprise clients.
actionable_insights: Evaluate your current RAG pipelines for aggregation/computation query failures and consider hybrid routing architectures.
Benchmark retrieval-based approaches against deterministic engines for large-scale tabular data to identify accuracy gaps.
Incorporate query classification or routing logic to improve reliability in production RAG deployments.
